answer: Because each relic escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the garden ledger records every share and the canyon audit shows the split. A bond must be split across 6 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Assembling that for 66 aliases means 66 times 6 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 35 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
